briefs.title: Tom Tiffany Plane Makes Emergency Landing in Lake Wausau
briefs.description: Rep. Tom Tiffany and a pilot escaped with minor injuries after a small plane lost power and made an emergency water landing in Lake Wausau, Wisconsin.

briefs.title: What the Hurricane Forecast Cone Really Means
briefs.description: A source-based explainer of the National Hurricane Center forecast cone, model guidance, forecast uncertainty, and why impacts can occur outside the cone.
